customer: Hello, I have an appraisal appointment coming up for my coupe and wanted to make sure I arrive prepared. I put a lot of miles on it commuting, and I'm still paying off the loan, so I don't have the title. Could you tell me what I should bring along? Thank you!
agent: Thanks for checking ahead! Per our article "What to bring to your appraisal appointment," please bring a valid photo ID for every owner listed on the title, the current registration, all keys and remotes, and the odometer statement (form NW-ODO-1), which you can also fill in at the store. Since you still have a loan, bring your payoff letter instead of the title; see "Getting a payoff letter" for details. Plan for the appointment to take about an hour.
